description:
The French Country 6 Drawer Dresser has six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides for clothing, bedding, and nursery essentials.

It measures 55 inches wide, 33 inches high, and 22 inches deep, and it is crafted from solid wood with the signature French Country detailing.
title: French Country 6 Drawer Dresser
metaDescription: The French Country 6 Drawer Dresser has six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides and solid wood construction.
